top_signals.title: Wheat Hits Three-Year High as Russia Prepares to Escalate War
top_signals.summary: Chicago wheat extended its rally to a three-year high, as concerns grow that the war between Russia and Ukraine could escalate and further disrupt supplies from one of the world’s most important breadbaskets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Putin Moves to Escalate War in Ukraine
top_signals.summary: Russia is preparing to escalate attacks on Ukraine after concluding that negotiations for a peace deal have reached a dead end, according to three people close to the Kremlin. Bloomberg's Michael Heath shares what we know. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Kids will be kids, and that’s the biggest risk with Meta’s new safeguards
top_signals.summary: Guardrails can only work as well as a company's ability to accurately identify a user's age, and young people around the world have repeatedly found ways to get past restrictions.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: The foreigners missing in Nepal’s flash floods
top_signals.summary: Official figures suggested at least 341 foreigners were among the missing after devastating floods that have killed at least 160 people.
